important_actions: action: Infiltrated the Imperial Palace, mirroring a feat attributed to his father Othon von Salza; source_refs: ['230_The_Metabarons_9_p01']

action: Destroyed the Purple Endoguard and declared himself the new Metabaron, ending hereditary Metabaron service to the Imperial House; source_refs: ['234_The_Metabarons_9_p05', '235_The_Metabarons_9_p06']
action: Broke from Metabaron tradition of imperial loyalty and publicly adopted a mercenary-for-hire stance; source_refs: ['235_The_Metabarons_9_p06']
action: Organized civilian relocation of an entire displaced population to the Teflon satellite; source_refs: ['238_The_Metabarons_9_p10']
knowledge_boundaries: Aware of the prior pact with Oda that their son would not become a Metabaron; overridden by Honorata's reincarnation scheme
The exact nature of the tentacled being he is obsessed with at Anasirma is not explained in source pages
The outcome of his duel with Steelhead is unresolved within volume 9
relationships: character: Othon von Salza; relation: Son; inherits Othon's feat of infiltrating the Imperial Palace; face resembles Othon in old age

character: Oda / Honorata; relation: Partner; father of their son Steelhead; prior agreement with Oda that their child would not become a Metabaron; shot in the head by Oda/Honorata during mental struggle
character: Honorata; relation: Antagonist; Honorata reincarnated inside Oda's body; Aghnar vows to return and duel his son to destroy Honorata's influence
character: Steelhead; relation: Son; adversary in the culminating father-son lethal duel per Metabaron tradition
character: The Empress; relation: Employer by contract; worked under contract to eliminate enemies of the Imperial Golden Planet
character: Ulritch the Red; relation: Temporary ally; piracy operation hijacking epiphyte cargo
character: General Thato; relation: Antagonist by implication; Aghnar's infiltration and destruction of the Purple Endoguard humiliates Thato's security apparatus
voice_notes: Declares himself the superior weapon when confronting armed forces (233_The_Metabarons_9_p04)
Expresses self-loathing and frustration at a life reduced to violence and intoxication (239_The_Metabarons_9_p11)
Warned Honorata he would return to challenge and destroy his son before leaving after decapitation (229_The_Metabarons_9_ic1)
witnessed_facts: fact: Survived decapitation: body attached to a machine to continue living; source_refs: ['229_The_Metabarons_9_ic1']
fact: Honorata reincarnated inside Oda's body; Oda bore a son and urged Aghnar to make him the greatest warrior; source_refs: ['229_The_Metabarons_9_ic1']
fact: Infiltrated the Imperial Palace by bypassing poly-radars, quantum sensors, and photonic barriers; source_refs: ['230_The_Metabarons_9_p01']
fact: His severed feet appeared inside the palace, causing security panic before his full presence was revealed; source_refs: ['231_The_Metabarons_9_p02', '232_The_Metabarons_9_p03']
fact: Destroyed the Purple Endoguard as a demonstration of power; source_refs: ['234_The_Metabarons_9_p05']

fact: Publicly claimed the title of new Metabaron and auctioned his services; bidding war lasted hours; source_refs: ['234_The_Metabarons_9_p05', '235_The_Metabarons_9_p06', '236_The_Metabarons_9_p07']
fact: Mercenary campaigns: aided Gords against the aquatic Hireas on Planet Sec-Hum; suppressed machine revolt on Nibal for the Zerkots; source_refs: ['236_The_Metabarons_9_p07']

fact: Led the Troglosocialik armada against the aristocratic Cybergs; allied with pirate Ulritch the Red to hijack an epiphyte cargo from three mother-coach ships; source_refs: ['237_The_Metabarons_9_p08-p09']

fact: Under contract to the Empress: single-handedly destroyed a 300,000-soldier battalion at Jupiter Nova in approximately eight minutes; organized relocation of Morga-the-Beautiful inhabitants to the Teflon satellite; source_refs: ['238_The_Metabarons_9_p10']

fact: Aged roughly twenty years in the ruins of his hidden lair on Anasirma; declined into massacres, drunkenness, and obsessive fixation on a tentacled being; source_refs: ['239_The_Metabarons_9_p11']
fact: Was interrupted mid-suicide-attempt by Pthagurean ambassadors bearing a massive kublar offer; source_refs: ['240_The_Metabarons_9_p12']
fact: Faces Steelhead in a father-son lethal duel at the center of a galaxy-scale battle; cliffhanger unresolved; source_refs: ['249_The_Metabarons_9_p22']
